name: Makerspace Operations
audience: community makerspaces, fabrication labs, and shared technical workshops
topic: equipment training authorization and machine downtime handoffs

products.name: Equipment Training Authorization
products.product: A focused makerspace equipment training authorization tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: community makerspaces, fabrication labs, and shared technical workshops
products.problem: Membership, waiver, orientation, machine-specific training, supervised practice, expiration, suspension, and access-control state can diverge before a member uses higher-risk equipment.
products.valueProposition: Turns makerspace equipment training authorization tracking into a visible operating queue so every equipment access grant is tied to current membership, documented prerequisites, named trainer approval, policy version, and matching access-control state.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets makerspace training tracker, equipment authorization software, fablab access control, and makerspace member certification searches.

products.name: Machine Downtime Handoff
products.product: A focused makerspace machine downtime and maintenance tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: community makerspaces, fabrication labs, and shared technical workshops
products.problem: A CNC, laser cutter, printer, saw, kiln, or shop tool is tagged out, but bookings, member notices, diagnosis, parts, volunteer ownership, safety review, and return testing are not synchronized.
products.valueProposition: Turns makerspace machine downtime and maintenance tracking into a visible operating queue so every equipment incident immediately blocks affected access and bookings, transfers with named repair ownership, and restores only after the required review and test.
products.topic: makerspace machine downtime and maintenance tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets makerspace maintenance software, fablab equipment downtime, makerspace machine booking outage, and shared workshop maintenance searches.
